title: 第4章 淘宝权和反向Q
slug: 什么叫我鲸吞了lpl的气运
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

LGD基地比平时安静得多。

每逢比赛日，基地总会空出一大半。人都去了现场，剩下的只有几个无精打采的工作人员，以及留守训练室的替补。

窗外天色见暗，偌大的训练室里，只有几台显示器还亮着。

GodV戴着耳机，陷在电竞椅里打韩服高分局。

屏幕上，妖姬对沙皇。

他的打法依旧侵略性十足。

三级一波盲视野盲现踩上去，双校准精准链住，紧接着挂上引燃，硬生生把对面的闪现逼了出来。

可下一秒，切回来的小地图上，队友在野区送了一波节奏，刚滚起来的雪球瞬间断档。

韦神皱了皱眉，嘴里低声嘟囔了两句。

键盘旁边，手机被随手立在支架上。

LPL官方直播间正放着LGD对阵VG的赛前画面，解说的声音隔着耳机，断断续续地混杂在韩服的技能音效里。

“……好，可以看到今天LGD首发阵容做出了人员调整。中单位上，由新人替补选手Tree登场……”

韦神掀起眼皮扫了一眼屏幕，随即收回视线，切回游戏。

这时，耳机里传来了QQ的提示音，他拿起手机切到qq界面，发现是TBQ发来的消息。

“真不上？”

韦神一边控线，一边单手用语音回道：“懒得去。”

没过几秒，TBQ直接一记语音弹了过来。

韦神顺手接通，把手机丢在鼠标垫旁。

TBQ那边背景音有些嘈杂，夹杂着风声，似乎在室外。

“你真不怕啊？”TBQ开门见山。

“怕什么？”

“替补都抬上去了。”

听到这句话，韦神握着鼠标的手顿了半秒，随即笑了一声。

“Heart现在就是死马当活马医。”

“1-8的开局，不换人他能怎么办？等死吗？”

话筒那头，TBQ继续说道：“你就不怕新人乱杀，把你的位置给顶了？”

TBQ，又名淘宝权，前LGD打野，在S5世界赛上打出了震惊全球的表现，这么说吧，打出反向Q操作的GodV都留下了，淘宝权离队了。

“没什么好担心的，Tree留不下来。”韦神语气笃定。

屏幕上，妖姬一记魔影迷踪踩过墙，一套不解释连招瞬间蒸发了对面的沙皇。

在电话那头的淘宝权心情有些复杂，是啊，他知道，韦神说的是对的。

职业圈一直都是这样，有些位置，能随便换，有些位置，换不了。

打野其实就是典型的消耗品位置。

这几年的LPL，打野换得跟流水一样，状态差了就换，下手不够狠换，节奏不对换，输了两场比赛都可能直接被按下去。

一个队伍能没有顶级打野，但很难没有顶级中单。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The LGD base was much quieter than usual.

On game days, most of the base is always empty.Everyone went to the scene, leaving only a few listless staff members and the substitutes who stayed in the training room.

It was getting dark outside the window, and in the huge training room, only a few monitors were still on.

GodV is wearing headphones and is stuck in the e-sports chair playing the high-score game of the Korean server.

On the screen, the enchantress versus the tsar.

His style of play is still aggressive.

A third-level wave of blind vision stepped on it, and the double calibration accurately linked it, and then set it up to ignite, forcefully forcing the opposite flash out.

But the next second, on the mini-map that was switched back, teammates sent a wave of rhythm in the wild area, and the snowball that had just rolled stopped instantly.

Wei Shen frowned and muttered a few words in a low voice.

Next to the keyboard, the mobile phone was casually standing on a stand.

The LPL official live broadcast room is showing the pre-match footage of LGD vs. VG. The voice of the commentator is intermittently mixed with the sound effects of the Korean server's skills through the headphones.

"...Okay, you can see that LGD's starting lineup has made personnel adjustments today. In the mid unit, the new substitute player Tree will appear..."

Wei Shen raised his eyelids and glanced at the screen, then withdrew his gaze and switched back to the game.

At this time, the QQ prompt sound came from the earphones. He picked up the phone and switched to the QQ interface and found that it was a message from TBQ.

"Really not?"

While controlling the line, Wei Shen replied with one hand with his voice: "I'm too lazy to go."

Within a few seconds, TBQ directly played a voice message.

Wei Shen answered the call smoothly and threw the phone next to the mouse pad.

The background sound at TBQ was a bit noisy, mixed with the sound of wind, as if it was outdoors.

"Are you really not afraid?" TBQ got straight to the point.

"What are you afraid of?"

"All the substitutes have been brought up."

Upon hearing this, Wei Shen's hand holding the mouse paused for half a second, and then laughed.

"Heart is now a dead horse and a live doctor."

"With a 1-8 start, what will he do without substitution? Will he wait to die?"

On the other end of the phone, TBQ continued: "Aren't you afraid that the newcomers will kill you and take your position?"

TBQ, also known as Taobao Quan, is a former LGD jungler who performed in a world-shaking performance in the S5 World Championship. Let's put it this way, GodV who played the reverse Q operation stayed, and Taobao Quan left the team.

"There's nothing to worry about. Tree can't stay." Wei Shen said firmly.

On the screen, the enchantress stepped over the wall with a magic shadow, and a set of unexplained combos instantly evaporated the tsar opposite.

Taobao Quan's mood on the other end of the phone was a little complicated. Yes, he knew that Wei Shen was right.

This has always been the case in the professional world. Some positions can be changed at will, while some positions cannot.

The jungle is actually a typical consumable location.

In the LPL in the past few years, junglers have been replaced as if they were in a hurry. If the condition is bad, they will be replaced. If the attack is not strong enough, the rhythm will not be changed. If they lose two games, they may be directly pressed.

A team can be without a top jungler, but it is difficult to be without a top midlaner.
